命运指引着我的每一步。我穿越了无边的黑暗来到你的面前。我是神谕者尤拉斯塔尔。
excerpt.en:
The alien is motionless.

Fate guides my steps. I have crossed the blind reaches to stand before you. I am Ulastar, the Oracle.

texts.zh:
这位外星人一动不动。

命运指引着我的每一步。我穿越了无边的黑暗来到你的面前。我是神谕者尤拉斯塔尔。
texts.en:
The alien is motionless.

Fate guides my steps. I have crossed the blind reaches to stand before you. I am Ulastar, the Oracle.

label.zh: 你能说说我们的命运吗？
label.en: What can you say about our destiny?

responses.zh:
他仿佛用那双盲眼凝视着。

在一条路上，白色的火焰在虚空中燃烧。另一条则覆满飞溅的余烬。你们将面对恐怖，那将是你们的毁灭。除非？命运之线织出最微弱的希望。厄运或许可以避免。
responses.en:
He stares with blind eyes.

On one path, a white flame burns against the void. Along the other lies a sputtering ember. You will face Terror, and it shall be your undoing. Unless? The threads of fate weave the thinnest hope. Doom may yet be averted.

label.en: Why do you seek to join us?

responses.zh:
他从一个隐藏的袋子里扔出一团旋转的尘埃。当他说话时，就通过这样的方式做出宣告：

我受到召唤而来。你们必会或必将遇见我。
responses.en:
From a hidden pouch he flings a swirling cloud of dust. When he speaks, he does so as a proclamation:

I came because I was called. You have sought me out. Or perhaps you will.

label.en: What exactly will you do for us?

responses.zh:
从长袍的内袋中，尤拉斯塔尔翻出了一套雕刻的骨头。将它们抛到地上后，他似乎在通过某种超越视觉的感官在观察这些骨头的摆放。

我会与信徒分享我之所见。我会在你的民族之船即将坠入风暴时将它扶正。
responses.en:
From the folds of his robes Ulastar produces a set of carved bones. Scattering them across the floor, he appears to study the pattern with senses beyond sight.

I will share my visions with the faithful. I will right the ship of your nation as it prepares to plunge into the storm.

label.en: How did you come by your gifts?

responses.zh:
许多年前，我在一个行星矿坑里辛苦工作。虽然我的肉眼能看见，但我的心之眼却被物质世界蒙蔽了。后来，我觉醒的那一天到来了。

他们说这是意外，但我知道这是天意。突然的爆炸声炸裂了我的视觉神经。在随后的黑暗中，我看到了时间之河。直到今天，它还在我眼前汩汩流淌。
responses.en:
Many years ago, I toiled in the pits of a planetary mine. Though my physical body could see, my soul was blinded by the material world. Then came the day of my awakening.

They called it an accident, but I know it was providence; a sudden explosion fried my optical nerves. In the darkness that followed, I perceived the river of time. To this day, it flows before my eyes.

tooltips.en: Ulastar joins our empire as a Leader.

texts.zh: 多年来，神秘人[Root.GetName]解读了许多揭示更大命运的征兆和预示。现在，[Root.GetSheHe]宣称预见到了整个星系将会统一在一面旗帜下的画面——而那正是我们的旗帜。真正的辉煌还在后头。
texts.en: For many years, [Root.GetName] the Mystic has interpreted signs and portents that reveal a greater destiny. Now, [Root.GetSheHe] claims a vision of the galaxy united under a single banner - our own. The real splendor is still to come.

label.zh: 伟大的荣耀等待着我们。

texts.zh: 多年来，[Root.GetName]一直通过强大的灵能梦向虚空呼喊。现在，几艘载有许多物种成员的民用飞船出现在[planet_governed.GetName]轨道上。他们愿意为我们服务，以期和他们的先知一起生活。
texts.en: For years, [Root.GetName] has been calling out into the void via powerful psionic dreams. Now, several civilian ships carrying members of many species have appeared in orbit around [planet_governed.GetName]. In exchange for a chance to live with their prophet, they are willing to serve us.

label.zh: 他们将会加入我们的族群。
label.en: They will be a part of our flock.

summary.text:
# 尤拉斯塔尔 / Ulastar

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/paragon_events_4.txt:1530-1628、3567-3594, 3598-3662、1728–1866（paragon.41234）、15–160（paragon.40000/40001）· DLC：典范 Galactic Paragons · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

“知名领袖”抽签：每十年（on_decade_pulse_country）隐藏事件 paragon.40000 检查（典范DLC、玩家、非杀戮帝国、已研究外星语言学、近期未招募），按基础1（有招募办公室+2）对“随失败而递增”的权重决定是否在1–360天内抽签（40001）。抽签只放入与本国思潮相符、尚未出现过且未被解雇的领袖；本故事的人物属于**唯心**思潮（renowned_spiritualist1）。
Renowned leader lottery: each decade hidden paragon.40000 (Paragon, player, not homicidal, Xeno-Linguistics, no recent recruit) may draw within 1–360 days (40001); only leaders matching your ethics, not yet offered and not dismissed are in the pool. This one is **spiritualist**.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 招募对话：自称神谕者的神秘外星人。可反复询问（只显示回答），然后“解雇”或“招募”。
   Recruitment: a motionless alien calling itself the Oracle. Ask questions (replies only), then dismiss or enlist.
2. 招募后，每十年隐藏事件 paragon.41234 随机挑选一名知名领袖，对此人按10%/10%/80%抽取下面两段故事之一或都不发生，延迟1–1800天；两段都只发生一次，可在不同的十年里先后出现。
   After hiring, every decade paragon.41234 picks a renowned leader; for this one 10% / 10% / 80% (nothing), 1–1800 days later. Each episode fires once; both may happen in different decades.

- **伟大预言 / The Great Prophecy**（paragon.41510）：预言银河将统一在我们的旗帜下：获得修正（条件：正在治理人口不超过6000的星球）。
  it prophesies the galaxy united under our banner: a modifier.
- **追随召唤 / Heeding the Call**（paragon.41520）：灵能梦召来多物种信众：接纳（星球增加300唯心灵能人口）或（仅排外）拒绝（条件：正在治理一颗星球）。
  psionic dreams summon followers: accept 300 spiritualist psionic pops on the planet, or (xenophobes only) refuse.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- “解雇”：人物回到全局池，但本国设置 dismissed 标记，以后不会再抽到。“招募”：成为知名领袖（李萨拓等人另带舰队）。
  Dismiss: never offered to you again. Enlist: becomes a renowned leader.
- 两段后续是相互独立的随机事件，不是先后两章；领袖死亡或离开后不再发生。
  The two episodes are independent random events, not chapters in order.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 只有拥有唯心思潮的帝国会被提供此人。后续故事的额外条件见上（括号内）。
  Offered only to spiritualist empires; extra episode conditions are given in brackets above.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：40000/40001 抽签与权重（01_script_values_paragon.txt ethic_leader_randomizer）、招募事件全部选项、ethic_leader_hire_effect 设置领袖标记、41234 的分派与权重、后续事件的触发条件、选项与项目。
- 更正 Corrections：原先十六名领袖的招募对话被合成一个故事（按抽签器），而所有后续故事又被合成另一个故事；现按人物拆分，每人一则故事，招募后接各自的后续。
  The lottery-based story and the follow-up story were split into one story per leader.
- 不确定 Uncertain：每十年只随机挑选一名知名领袖进行判定，拥有多名知名领袖时后续可能更晚出现。
